filters_requested_but_not_applied.opportunity_evidence_score: No such metric exists anywhere in the LeadGraph/scenic-intelligence codebase or its data outputs. Not fabricated for this manifest.
filters_requested_but_not_applied.bedroom_count_2plus: Not tracked for this batch. The only structure-data connector in the codebase (RentCast, gauntlet/projects/leadgraph-v0.1/qualification-engine/src/sources/rentcast-connector.mjs) is allowlisted for Berkeley only, maps unitCount rather than bedroom count, and runs against a shared paid account (50 req/mo, $0.20/req overage) — expanding it to 65 Santa Rosa addresses is a real-money, scope-expanding decision that needs Justin's sign-off before it happens, not an assumption baked into a sales manifest.
filters_requested_but_not_applied.executive_finishes: No interior-condition or finish-quality data source is connected anywhere in this repo. Any score here would be fabricated.
filters_requested_but_not_applied.safety_profile: No crime/safety data source is connected anywhere in this repo. Any score here would be fabricated.

selection_methodology.rationale_for_absentee_filter_as_proxy: Absentee ownership is the one real, defensible signal in the current data: an owner who doesn't live at the property is more likely to already treat it as an investment/rental asset, which fits a 30+ day corporate-tenant hand-off model better than an owner-occupied primary residence. It is a proxy for landlord mindset, not for property size, finish quality, or safety.
selection_methodology.ordering: First 15 absentee-owner records in LG-001-M's original ingestion order (deterministic, not a quality ranking).
